bagPolicy.summary: Bags must not exceed 11 × 14 inches and are searched; clear bags are not required. The theatre may change the rule for an event.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Hollywood Park complex has multiple parking zones, and the theatre recommends buying parking before the event and arriving early.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use Hyundai Pink Zone Lot P for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Approach from Century Boulevard and Yukon Avenue, then enter Lot P from Yukon Avenue.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Drinks and snacks are sold at East and West bars on the Orchestra, Plaza and Balcony levels; food trucks operate outside. One factory-sealed 20 oz water bottle or an empty refillable plastic bottle is allowed.
allowed: One factory-sealed water bottle up to 20 oz
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The theatre FAQ links to venue-specific accessibility guidance for seating and accommodation requests.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theatre FAQ does not publish a universal re-entry policy for concertgoers.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Box Office by Ticketmaster is at Entry 7 and is open Wednesday through Friday, 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. On event days it opens three hours before the event start for ticket help, though hours can vary.

gates.summary: West B, next to the Box Office, is the designated entry for all shows, and every entry has an accessible path. A Mobility Ambassador is posted there to help you to your seat if you ask.
